[size=4][b]What it does:[/b][/size]
Quite simply, I did not like the machine like artisan equipment in the game. So I changed them to more primitive, non-mechanical looking things.
Admittedly some do not make sense now, like why would a bucket full of diamonds make gems, but I like the way they look around the farm more.
Not everything was changed, only the things in the image. Some things were either already 'primitive' or I simply had little idea how to alter them.

Also the incubator is no longer taller than the player. I changed and included it just because it annoyed me and no other reason.

There is a known issue in 1.1 with an initial bust of smoke out of the charcoal furnace being above the current sprite. I cannot lower it and my version  looked kinda bad when I made it taller to match the old one. It only lasts for a second though so I'm not too bothered.
_________________________

[size=4][b]Installation:
[/b][/size][b]For Stardew Valley 1.1
1 - Backup your files before installing this mod if you ever want to revert your craftable items.[/b]
2 - Put the "Content" folder into your Stardew Valley folder, overwriting the existing files. The typical installation directory for Steam is going to be something like "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley"

There is an alternate version that includes my owl scarecrows from my other mod, since they overwrite the same file.

The optional download is not necessary for most users. It is a .png file of my machines fitted to the template for craftables.xnb.
If you use multiple mods that replace the same file and know how to edit the game's textures you can add them yourself, though I ask you do not distribute them without my permission first.
